name: Le Meridien Chicago - Oakbrook Center
positioning: Art-focused Le Meridien hotel in suburban Oak Brook, Illinois, beside the Oakbrook Center shopping center
best_for: Shoppers who want to stay across the street from Oakbrook Center
Art lovers who want free museum entry with their key card

facts.text: The hotel is in Oak Brook, Illinois, beside the Oakbrook Center shopping center, which is across the street.
The hotel offers access to Drury Lane Theatre, the Elmhurst Art Museum and downtown Chicago.
Le Meridien Hub is a modern reinterpretation of the traditional hotel lobby, with Mid Century design, furnishings inspired by Mies van der Rohe and a mural.
Rooms and suites feature design-forward decor and original artwork, with LM Platform Beds and high-speed Wi-Fi throughout.
Deluxe rooms are corner rooms with extra window views of the courtyard or city streets.
Executive Suites offer generous space and sweeping views; Presidential suites have a boardroom table for eight.
Spa Suites offers treatments such as couples massages, facials, body scrubs and in-suite massages.
Longitude 87 serves modern American cuisine for breakfast and dinner, with outdoor dining and an Illy coffee bar.
The Lizzadro Museum of Lapidary Art, one of the partner museums, houses a collection of Chinese jade and hard-stone carvings.
The fitness center is open 24 hours a day, seven days a week.
The hotel is dog-friendly, providing a dog bed, food and water bowls and a floor mat.
Self parking is complimentary for guests.

highlights.text: Guests get free entry to the Elmhurst Art Museum and the Lizzadro Museum by showing their artist-designed key card.
El Tapeo, on the ninth floor, serves Spanish-inspired dining with sweeping views of the surrounding skyline.
Spa Suites offers treatments in a tranquil private suite.
Premium rooms sit on higher floors with elevated views and come with robes and slippers.
The Le Meridien Bicycle Programme gives guests complimentary use of bicycles to explore Oak Brook.

considerations.text: The minimum age to check in is 21.
WhataHotel notes the suburban location means you will need transportation to reach downtown Chicago.
Chicago O'Hare International Airport is about 16 miles away.
